admission: General minimum-stack metadata; smallest compatible existing free pool; ERROR_NO_FREE_STORE before child identity or entry, with Attach rollback

resident_provider_allowances.basis: Reserved planning caps for step 3; remeasure and redesign before exceeding either cap

source_frames.method: For each retained emitted source section, sum immediate TSC/SBC/TCS reservations and all static push sites at 16-bit width, plus three bytes at each call/tail edge. This overcounts disjoint branches. Compiler-balanced loops reuse their stack. Cross-call and cross-function tail sharing are disabled. Typed callbacks and finite action contexts are audited below; new indirect sites or cycles reject the report.
source_frames.limit: Source-frame bound only. The continuation cap includes bridge and library/native/GEM work below an application call; future implemented GUI paths must establish that cap and sample full chains before editor execution is qualified. Current runtime samples are separate execution evidence, not a bound on missing GEM.

delete_edit may invoke Save once; Save does not invoke delete_edit
load_edit/new_edit/restore_edit use Open or unchecked Delete

observer: Passive selected entries and actual emitted TCS sites; physical pool and DP with per-pool Process.Run lifetime ordinal. Broad preliminary traces were stopped to reduce instrumentation overhead; passing runs use the narrowed marker set. Stack windows identify the owned Process from PREPARING to retirement; final analysis selects its pool and first observed lifetime. Later history samples are excluded.
